s: Pull-based time-series metrics engine (Prometheus-style) computing golden signals and firing alert rules.
w: Scrapers poll /metrics endpoints on targets; samples land in TSDB with label dimensions. PromQL queries aggregate/filter (rate(), histogram_quantile()). Rule evaluators run periodically firing alerts to managers. Federations/remote-write scale horizontally; service discovery keeps target lists current.
use: HPA autoscaling signal sources (custom metrics APIs)
SLI computation feeding error-budget burn alerts
pits: Cardinality explosions from unbounded labels (user_id!) - whitelist label sets strictly
tips: Golden signals fluency: latency/traffic/errors/saturation per service
